say:2:1120316001:1.text: Is this enough for you, Smokey?
say:2:1120316001:1.source_cn: 阿熏，你看这些草药够吗？

say:3:1120316002:1.text: Let me see... Yep, that should do the trick!
say:3:1120316002:1.source_cn: 让我看看……嗯，应该差不多了。

say:4:1120316003:1.text: However, there's still one crucial step that can only be performed at my house. Which of you wants to come with me?
say:4:1120316003:1.source_cn: 不过，有个步骤必须得在我家制作，你们看看谁跟我过去？

say:5:1120316004:1.text: Soren, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you two go ahead. I'll stay here with Karun...
say:5:1120316004:1.male: Soren, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you two go ahead. I'll stay here with Karun...
say:5:1120316004:1.female: Soren, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you two go ahead. I'll stay here with Karun...

say:6:1120316005:1.text: Karun's condition is much more stable now. Once I administer the potion, he'll make a full recovery!
say:6:1120316005:1.source_cn: 卡鲁恩的情况很稳定了，只要再加上药剂，一定能恢复健康！
say:6:1120316005:1.male: Karun's condition is much more stable now. Once I administer the potion, he'll make a full recovery!
say:6:1120316005:1.female: Karun's condition is much more stable now. Once I administer the potion, he'll make a full recovery!

say:9:1120316006:1.text: Don't worry, Alsa, we'll be back soon!
say:9:1120316006:1.source_cn: 阿尔萨，不要太焦虑，我们很快回来！
say:9:1120316006:1.male: Don't worry, Alsa, we'll be back soon!
say:9:1120316006:1.female: Don't worry, Alsa, we'll be back soon!
